artifact_observations.location: Junction of neck, scarf, and helmet

Background elements exhibit inconsistent focus and slight warping, typical of AI generation struggling with depth of field in complex scenes.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plasticity' of the metal reflections. Real polished steel should have sharp, high-contrast reflections. If the expert finds the reflections are too diffuse or 'painted', this indicates a generative artifact. Also, scrutinize the helmet-neck junction for impossible geometry.
